properties.site-address: Caravan Tech premises, High Street, Hurst Green
properties.notes: This site is proposed to be allocated in the DaSA for some 15 dwellings, of which 40% are affordable. This is an existing retail/commercial site so development is dependent upon the relocation of the current occupier. Vehicular access should be provided off the A21 and the scheme layout should retain a frontage onto the A21. The scheme layout should respect neighbouring amenities.. See draft Policy HUR2 in the DaSA (https://www.rother.gov.uk/CHttpHandler.ashx?id=27128&p=0)
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
